quote_a: Each rack bay carries up to 3,000 kg
quote_b: Never place more than 2,700 kg in a single bay
explanation: Bay capacity is 3,000 kg in Operations §2.2 but 2,700 kg in §6.2; the canon (F-LIM-07) says 2,700 kg.

quote_b: All cycle counts follow the PR-08 rota
explanation: Operations §5.1 points cycle counts at PR-09 (damaged goods) while §5.2 points at PR-08.

quote_a: The indoor speed limit is 12 km/h
quote_b: Inside the building the limit is 10 km/h
explanation: Operations §6.1 sets the indoor limit at 12 km/h while Health & Safety §1.1 sets it at 10 km/h; the canon (F-LIM-01) says 10 km/h.

quote_a: Chilled deliveries are accepted at up to +10 °C
quote_b: The cold zone never rises above +8 °C
explanation: Operations §1.2 accepts chilled goods up to +10 °C, but the SLA §2.1 guarantees storage never above +8 °C (F-LIM-09).

quote_a: Returns staff inspect goods in Zone F
quote_b: Returns are inspected in Zone D
explanation: Job Descriptions §1.3 places returns inspection in Zone F while the SLA §1.2 places it in Zone D; the canon (F-ZON-14) says Zone F.

quote_a: The shift supervisor approves all write-offs
quote_b: Write-offs above 500 EUR need the warehouse manager
explanation: Job Descriptions §1.2 gives all write-offs to the supervisor, but the SLA §1.1 requires the manager above 500 EUR (F-RSP-02, F-RSP-03).
